findings.source: Wolfhound: А тех, что не хватает...
findings.objectiveReason: The antecedent is his missing teeth, explicitly meno in the previous unit. Russian plural тех and target plural class 6 require yale/hayapo, not ile/haipo class 9 singular.

findings.source: Wolfhound: Ну пусть их в могиле покрепче сжимают те ублюдки.
findings.currentTarget: Wolfhound: Basi wale wapumbavu waibane zaidi kaburini.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Wolfhound: Basi wale wapumbavu wayabane zaidi kaburini.
findings.objectiveReason: их refers to the missing teeth of the preceding unit. wa-i-bane is class 9 singular object; wa-ya-bane preserves plural class 6 teeth.
